changeSet.sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp"; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS integration.notification ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() NOT NULL, data_id UUID, type TEXT, user_id UUID, title_uz TEXT, title_ru TEXT, title_en TEXT, body_uz TEXT, body_ru TEXT, body_en TEXT, image TEXT, username VARCHAR, is_viewed BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, deleted BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, created_user_id UUID, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS integration_idx_notification_user ON integration.notification (user_id);

changeSet.author: qodiriy
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO integration.notification (id, data_id, type, user_id, title_uz, title_ru, title_en, body_uz, body_ru, body_en, image, username, is_viewed, deleted, created_user_id, created_at, updated_at) SELECT id, data_id, type, user_id, title_uz, title_ru, title_en, body_uz, body_ru, body_en, image, username, is_viewed, deleted, created_user_id, created_at, updated_at FROM notification.notification ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;
